mentions.name: userplane
mentions.description: Open-source screen recording tool (an alternative to Loom/Jam/Birdie/Screendesk) that captures the screen recording along with console logs, network requests, and session activity to help get to the root cause of issues faster.
mentions.problem: Identifying the root cause of issues is slower without the technical context that accompanies what happened on screen.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on an open-source alternative to Loom/Jam/Birdie/Screendesk

It captures the screen recording along with console logs, network requests, and session activity so you can get to the root cause faster

https://github.com/0xnyn/userplane
mentions.author: 0xnyn
